fixes: SDK snapshot hydration is serialized and observes current authorization
Upload receipt acceptance cannot be downgraded by a concurrent late error
Known server authorization denial clears all downloaded bytes and mirrored read views even with pending or unsaved drafts
Native download cache writes recheck scope, current authorization generation and replicated file permission in the same SQLite transaction
Offline-start uses the SDK retry loop; native auth callback network failures are handled without persisting tokens
Session abort cancels stale native requests; account switching never waits for an offline native WebSocket close handshake
Session initialization completion is guarded by generation and resources are disposed before reuse
Local test signer enforces loopback socket/Host and same-origin browser requests; tokens and credential APIs are not cached
designLimits: Pending local CRUD can prevent PowerSync checkpoint application. Native authorization signals provide the fail-closed cache guard while preserving the SDK queue and authored recovery work. Tombstones alone cannot immediately revoke that pending cache.
The local signer is test-only; live Clerk and Microsoft interactive sign-in are outside these pilot browser cases.
Meeting-pilot sync is isolated. Production credential delivery and complete document/material ACL, external identity and expiry invalidation are still required before full production replication.
Chromium browser emulation, not physical mobile devices or Electron packaging.
Loopback endpoints are on this cloud workspace, not the user Mac or Zoer host.
